# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** School-aged boy, roughly nine or ten years old in June of his initial year at Brierley school, and around twelve by his final year  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c1 P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c1 P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a dark-complexioned boy with dark, gloomily glaring black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P24](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0024)_

## Personality

Anthony has a cheeky, independent, and sullen disposition. He possesses a defiant, impertinent swagger and a habit of showing disdain toward authority, particularly female teachers. However, he is also clever and respects strength, coming to appreciate those who stand up to him or demonstrate physical capability.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P24](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0024), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c30 P6](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0006)_

- Cheeky and sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P24](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0024)</sub>

- Clever student when engaged  <sub>[v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony Tulk moved to Brierley to live with his aunt, Mrs. Laurence Tulk, and enrolled at the local school. Initially taught under Mr. Pidgeon, he later fell under the instruction of Nell Harcourt, whom he initially disdained because of her gender. On her first day, he glared at her and openly stated his dislike for female teachers. Months later, he poured slate water down a classmate's neck and put a mouse in Nell's desk drawer. After being punished with a hardwood pointer, his attitude shifted, and he began showing respect and helpfulness toward Nell. He later joined the advanced class preparing for the Entrance examination, though he expressed doubt about the value of higher education for orphans. After failing to pass his exams on the first attempt, he returned to Brierley school for a second year before eventually passing and leaving for the West.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c1 P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020), [v2 c30 P21](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0021), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_
